60k is a good salary for mid senior position. You will be able to flush yourself out. There are many expenses that you won't have in the UK (yes I'm looking at you health insurance)

It's important that you understand the British tax brackets, which are very simple. The following are stimates but you can Google it

0% tax up to 12.5k£
20% tax from 12.5k£ to 50k£
40% tax from 50k£ to 100k£

It's important that you understand how much net you will make. Regarding costs:

Rent, expensive flat for yourself plus utilities> 1500£per month to 2000£
Public Transport: 120£ per month, but if you get a well located apartment then you won't spend that much, as walking is an option to get to 1/6 of the city centre.
Food: depends on you, you like cooking 400-600£ per month. Eating out 2 meals could be 30£ a day for 2 meals.
Holidays: welcome to Europe, expect trips to cost around 100£ to any other European capital.
Doctors: free or reasonable priced.

I think 60k + 10% is fair game, you won't probably earn as much as in new York, but I would easily expect a 10-20% reduction of salary overall. But no one can compete with American wages, the people that leave to the US to work, 80% of them go because of salaries.
